thread:
rachel: Quick thread: we're shipping the v2 SDK tomorrow. Noticed docs still reference the old `route` param for model routing. That will error in v2 (it's now `preferred_route`). Need a tiny migration blurb + sample code for JS/Python and a short note in the changelog.

anand: Good catch. Can we add a one-liner table showing mapping: `route` -> `preferred_route`, `model_alias` -> `model_id`? Also mention behavior: if both present v2 ignores `route`.

docs-bot: New draft PR by rachel: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/13111 1 files changed 1 CI checks queued.

pete: Devrel asks to include copy for the community post. Keep it simple: example before/after + upgrade checklist (update SDK, run smoke tests, search/replace `route:` in codebase).

rachel: Proposed JS snippet for the migration guide:
```js
// v1 (old)
client.invoke({ model: 'chat-1', route: 'low-latency', input: 'hi' })
// v2 (new)
client.invoke({ model: 'chat-2', preferred_route: 'low-latency', input: 'hi' })
```

qa-jen: I'll run a quick grep across example repos for `route:` and submit any failing snippets as fixes. Please tag me on the PR.

anand: Also add a short explanation about tenant overrides: customers using tenant-specific routing must set `X-Redwood-Tenant` header; docs should show how the header interacts with `preferred_route`.

pete: Can we add an inline curl example demonstrating header precedence?

rachel: Added curl example to the PR: ```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v2/invoke \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $RW_KEY" \ 
  -H "X-Redwood-Tenant: acme-corp" \ 
  -d '{"model":"chat-2","preferred_route":"low-latency","input":"ping"}'
```

docs-bot: Preview site build started for PR 13111 (staging link: https://staging.docs.redwood.ai/sdk-v2-routing-migration).

anand: One more thing: SDK changelog should call out that sending `route` will now produce a deprecation-warning header `X-Deprecation-Route` until we remove it in 60 days. Add example expected header in docs.

qa-jen: Smoke tests ran: found 3 examples in `examples/`. I pushed fixes and linked them in the PR. All passing locally.

pete: Reviewed PR and left two non-blocking copy notes. Devrel will prepare a short tweet-thread and a community post coupling to the migration guide.

docs-bot: CI passed, ready to merge.

rachel: Merged. Follow-up: I'll open a small redirects PR to alias `/v1/routing` -> `/v2/routing-migration` and add the changelog blurb to the SDK release notes repo.

pete: Thanks everyone. I'll schedule the community post for tomorrow morning after the SDK release.

anand: Closing thread. Keep an eye on support for any unexpected errors from pinned SDK versions.
